targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfMinute(occurred_at) AS time, JSONExtractString(payload_json, 'provider') AS provider, count() AS calls FROM events_v1 WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at) AND event_type = 'model.call.completed' GROUP BY time, provider ORDER BY time

SELECT occurred_at, JSONExtractString(payload_json, 'stage') AS stage, JSONExtractString(payload_json, 'model') AS model, JSONExtractInt(payload_json, 'latency_ms') AS latency_ms, resource_id FROM events_v1 WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at) AND event_type = 'model.call.completed' ORDER BY occurred_at DESC LIMIT 100
